summary: Completed testing of WatchNexus Settings page (12 tabs) and Plugin Marketplace page (3 tabs) plus Plugin Adapter API endpoints. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings page successfully refactored from 2872 lines to 332 lines with 12 self-contained tab components
All 12 settings tabs working: General, Users, Library, Media Health, Indexers, Download Client, IPTV, Streaming Services, Subtitles, External Access, Theme Forge, Plugins
Plugin Marketplace has 3 working tabs: Kodi Repository (shows popular add-ons and categories), Installed (shows empty state), Convert Plugin (ecosystem buttons and file upload)
PluginConverter component extracted successfully with data-testid attributes for ecosystem buttons
Backend /api/adapter/supported returns list of 3 ecosystems (kodi, jellyfin, plex)
Backend /api/adapter/convert accepts file uploads with multipart/form-data and validates ZIP files
Auth flow works correctly with test@test.com / password credentials
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings page at /settings has 12 working tabs. Plugin Marketplace at /plugins has 3 tabs. Adapter APIs at /api/adapter/* working. Auth with test@test.com / password.

tabs_tested.General: Download Path, Library Path, Quality Preference, Save Settings button

tabs_tested.Kodi Repository: Shows Popular Add-ons (YouTube, Twitch, Trakt, TMDB, OpenSubtitles, etc.) and Browse by Category (Other, Video Add-ons, Scripts, Resources, Screensavers)
tabs_tested.Installed: Shows 'No plugins installed' empty state with guidance
tabs_tested.Convert Plugin: Plugin Converter with ecosystem buttons (Auto-detect, Kodi, Jellyfin/Emby, Plex), file upload area, and Supported Plugin Ecosystems info cards

auth_flow.login: POST /api/auth/login returns access_token and user object
auth_flow.me: GET /api/auth/me returns user info with auth header

POST /api/adapter/convert.accepts: multipart/form-data with file and optional ecosystem fields
